---
title: "Survival Analysis"
subtitle: "Kaplan-Meier forecasts and observed PFS"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_setup.R")
km_data     <- pub_tar_read("all_tumor_ssls_km_rvar")
obs_km_data <- pub_tar_read("km_trial_pfs") |>
  filter(fct_match(btype, "ub")) |>
  select(!quantiles) |>
  unnest(km_data)
```

## PFS Kaplan-Meier Curves {#sec-pfs-km}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based

```{r}
#| label: fig-pfs-km-sample
#| fig-cap: Sample-based PFS KM (posterior) by trial. Shaded band shows 80% credible interval.
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

km_data |>
  filter(fit_type == "posterior") |>
  plot_km(
    km_est_var  = sample_pfs_km_est,
    facet_col   = trial,
    obs_km_data = obs_km_data
  )
```

### Superpopulation

```{r}
#| label: fig-pfs-km-spop
#| fig-cap: Superpopulation PFS KM (posterior) by trial. Wider uncertainty than sample-based as it reflects a new patient drawn from the population.
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

km_data |>
  filter(fit_type == "posterior") |>
  plot_km(
    km_est_var  = spop_pfs_km_est,
    facet_col   = trial,
    obs_km_data = obs_km_data
  )
```

### Prior vs Posterior

```{r}
#| label: fig-pfs-km-prior-post
#| fig-cap: Prior vs posterior PFS KM (sample-based) by trial.
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

km_data |>
  plot_km(
    km_est_var  = sample_pfs_km_est,
    facet_col   = trial,
    group       = fit_type,
    alpha_group = fit_type
  )
```

:::
